title: BREAKING: Marco Antonio Fuentes Arrested on Aggravated Assault Charge
excerpt: Marco Antonio Fuentes was arrested October 26, 2026, by the Laredo Police Department on a second-degree felony charge of aggravated assault causing serious bodily injury, and booked into the Webb County Jail.
content:
BREAKING: Marco Antonio Fuentes was arrested on October 26, 2026, at 12:39 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department and booked into the Webb County Jail, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking record.

Fuentes is charged with aggravated assault causing serious bodily injury, a second-degree felony, and accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor. The charges are allegations, and Fuentes is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

No bond amounts were listed in the booking record at the time of this report.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
